column3: The Hebrew repeats God and presents speaking and calling as accomplished; BSB says Mighty One and uses present-tense verbs.
The Hebrew expresses a wish that God come and not be silent; BSB states that He approaches and will not be silent.
The Hebrew names My covenant; BSB says a covenant with Me.
The Hebrew says He will not take a bull from the house; BSB describes no need for a bull from a stall.
The Hebrew says the field creatures are with Him; BSB says they are His.
The Hebrew names the mouth; BSB says lips.
The Hebrew says his tongue harnesses deceit; BSB says he unharnesses his tongue for deceit.
The Hebrew says arranging before his eyes without an explicit object for the arrangement; BSB describes accusing him to his face.
The Hebrew says one who sets a way without explicitly naming his own way or making it right; BSB says one who rights his way.
